import sys

def main():
    arr = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
    if not arr:
        return
    s = arr[0]
    res = 0
    i = 0
    while i < len(s):
        length = 1
        while i + 1 < len(s) and s[i] == s[i+1]:
            length += 1
            i += 1
        if length % 2 == 0:
            res += 1
        i += 1
    print(res)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
